frontmatter.description: Read/draft Gmail, manage Calendar, and work with Drive as the connected Google account.

secrets.note: Ambient -- 'user' when the acting user has a Google Workspace connection (connectors/defs/google-workspace.ts, auth_path: oauth_guided), 'absent' otherwise. Set by buildSpawnEnv() (app/server/src/services/session-spawn-env.ts). Always check this before using Google/Docs/Gmail -- never fall back to another account.
Present only when GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CONNECTION=user. The connected account's address -- send/read mail and Docs ONLY as this address.

body:
# Google Workspace

Lets an agent send/read email and work with Docs/Sheets/Drive as the connected Google account (Settings -> Connectors -> Google Workspace), scoped to the granted products (Gmail, Calendar, Drive).

## Using it

Check `$GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CONNECTION` first:
- `user` -- `$USER_GOOGLE_EMAIL` names the account to act as. Never pick a different account from disk.
- `absent` -- the owner has no Google connection. Do not send mail; tell them to connect at Settings -> Account -> Google Workspace.

## Gotchas

- The connection is per-person and OAuth-based (`auth_path: oauth_guided`) -- if the server has no `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`/`GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` configured, the connector reports unavailable and no token is ever issued.
- Scope is limited to what the user granted at consent (`grantedProducts()` in `connectors/defs/google-workspace.ts`) -- do not assume Drive access just because Gmail is present.

See `app/server/src/connectors/defs/google-workspace.ts` and `docs/connectors/guides/google-workspace.md`.
